descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S07 「现成的 spec：在跨病人界面上完成的任务移到完成部分，按 Undo 又回来」 Existing spec: a task completed on the cross-patient screen moves to the completed part and comes back on Undo

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 On the view the list is grouped by patient, pending tasks first and completed tasks at the bottom; every task shows which patient it belongs to（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U1 One consolidated in-app end-of-day view lists every open task across all of the physician's patients, each attributed to its patient（UAT TC-07；TFA-92585 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given One Hospital patient with an open task 'Recheck potassium <ts>'

When Rounding list → Task Export → Mark task done → open Finished Tasks → Undo

Then The task moves to Finished Tasks, then back to pending; rounding:list shows done false at the end

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions (Hospital only; Nursing Home is S06)

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S07 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-07.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
